description: Generate the current TOTP two-factor code (RFC 6238) from a base32 secret — the same codes authenticator apps produce. Supports 6/8 digits, 30/60-second steps and SHA-1/256/512. Deterministic HMAC via Web Crypto; nothing is stored. Use this when an agent needs to rFC 6238 2FA codes from a base32 secret. x402 price $0.01/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
name: security_totp_generator
